title: Intestinal Organoid Dissociation and Nuclei Isolation for Single Cell ATAC-Seq
author: Heather Eckart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdeui3ew

steps.title: Dissociate organoids with TrypLE
steps.instruction: Incubate organoids in TrypLE for up to 20 min at 37 °C, pipetting the suspension up‑and‑down 5–10 times every 5 min and checking digestion progress with a hemocytometer until sufficient single cells are obtained.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS‑BSA
steps.instruction: Perform 1–2 washes of the freshly dissociated cells with PBS containing 0.04 % BSA (prepare by adding 20 µL BSA to 1 mL 1× PBS).

steps.title: Count cells after washing
steps.instruction: Determine the cell count after washing using a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Aliquot cells into tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 000–1 000 000 cells (200 000 cells were used in this experiment) into a 2‑mL tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells (first spin)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 300 × g (300 rcf) for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove all supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Add chilled lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL chilled Lysis Buffer to the pellet and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Incubate nuclei on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysed cells on ice for 4 min (time may vary with cell type; 4 min is specific for organoid samples).

steps.title: Add chilled wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL chilled Wash Buffer to the lysed cells and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge nuclei (second spin)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 × g (500 rcf) for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant without disrupting the nuclei pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend nuclei in diluted buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet in chilled Diluted Nuclei Buffer (1×) on ice, aiming for ~5 000 nuclei (assuming ~50 % loss during lysis).

steps.title: Assess nuclei integrity and concentration
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei with WGA and DAPI, then determine nuclei concentration using a hemocytometer.

steps.title: Optional: Filter debris with strainer
steps.instruction: If cell debris or large clumps are observed, pass the suspension through a 40 µm Flowmi Cell Strainer to minimize volume loss.

steps.title: Proceed to Chromium ATAC workflow
steps.instruction: Immediately continue with the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell ATAC Sequencing protocol as described in the Chromium Single Cell ATAC Solution User Guide.
